metadata.description: Cross-agent project management plugins: project contract, lifecycle, extension capabilities and behavior rules.

plugins.name: agent-pack
plugins.description: Deterministic Agent-extension capability management: inventory, doctor, bootstrap, sync, transfer, and reconcile Agent Plugins / Skills / MCP servers across Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, and project sources. Ships a stdio MCP.

plugins.name: agents-init
plugins.description: Initialize or migrate an Agent project contract (AGENTS.md, Project Profile, root launcher); ships with project-orchestrator, agent-pack and opinion-manager.

plugins.name: opinion-manager
plugins.description: Manage Agent behavior rules through templates, partial selection, blank iteration, and authorized-memory candidates, with complete previews and exact version locks.

plugins.name: project-orchestrator
plugins.description: Portable lifecycle orchestration with Case workspaces, legacy Task/Case compatibility, verified migrations, discovery and scoped Git delivery.
